consensus.verdict: Under exact polar semi-orthogonalization, RMS(O) = 1/sqrt(D). Multiplying by Moonlight factor s(D,K) = rho * sqrt(D) exactly cancels the dimensional dependence, keeping parameter RMS invariant at rho = 0.2. Output functional change RMS_y(Delta W x) ~ eta * rho * sqrt(K) is independent of D. Isometry audited at O(K^2) = 32x32 cost in RAM.
consensus.action: Integrated s(D,K) = rho * sqrt(max(D,K)) with rho=0.2 in Stiefel retractions and Whitebook.
